classes.name: index
classes.reason: _consume checks `if budget_ns and probe.NS() - started > budget_ns: return staged, True`, so each class_a file must be read once within the broadcast producer-time budget or the unit is dropped, and every other rank is held at the end-of-unit `barrier.wait()` while the consumer reads.

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report loops `for _pass in range(CLASS_B_READS)` doing plain `probe.read_staged` with no budget check, so the consumer simply blocks on 8 reads per file while all other ranks sit at the following `barrier.wait()`.
